description: MT-ITS is a software-based intelligent tutoring system embedded in an instrumented rifle's digital sight for training novice shooters in moving-target marksmanship using the Virtual Immersive Soldier Simulator.
title: MT-ITS (embedded moving-target marksmanship tutoring system)

description: A hybrid professional-development supplement to the MyTeachingPartner mathematics and science curricula, developed to support pre-kindergarten teachers through online demonstration videos, teaching challenges with expert feedback, teaching tips, and in-person workshops.
title: MTP-M/S Plus hybrid teacher support system
